ctxMarket: Attention is on Solana’s network activity and institutional flows, with ETF inflows reaching a 2026 high. Most major tokens saw a daily pullback, but Solana’s recent rally and transaction records remain in focus.
ctxTalking:
• Solana ETF inflows hit $33.5M in a day, the largest this year, amid rising network activity
• Galaxy is offering retail credit lines backed by Solana, Bitcoin, and Ethereum

ctxMatters: Large ETF inflows and new credit products suggest growing institutional and retail engagement with Solana. The launch of analytics platforms reflects a push to highlight network fundamentals over price alone. Recent technical upgrades and record transaction volumes reinforce Solana’s narrative as a high-activity blockchain.
ctxSignal:
